title: EX-40X

specs.material: Carbon Fiber Composite Shell with ABS Liner
specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

technical_analysis: Features Complex Laminate Construction (CLC) with PB-SNC2 peripheral belt reinforcement and R75 smooth shell geometry for glance-off impact energy redirection paired with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports. The interior utilizes One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
technical_analysis_2: Aerodynamic efficiency is paramount in the EX-40X design, featuring a streamlined chin bar and integrated spoiler system that minimizes drag at high speeds. The acoustic profile has been tuned through extensive wind tunnel testing to reduce turbulence noise entering the ear cups, resulting in a quieter ride compared to competitors in the same weight class. Ventilation channels are strategically placed to create a direct airflow path from the front intake to the rear exhaust, ensuring effective heat dissipation even during aggressive cornering.
technical_analysis_3: The fitment system employs Arai's signature multi-density padding architecture, providing a custom-like feel that accommodates various head shapes within the Intermediate Oval category. The retention system uses high-tensile strength webbing with double D-rings for secure locking, ensuring the helmet remains stable under extreme G-forces. This combination of lightweight materials and precise engineering makes the EX-40X an ideal choice for track days and high-performance street riding where every gram counts.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for Intermediate Oval head shape with a snug fit around the occiput.

yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Arai EX-40X. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.
marketing_description: Experience the Arai EX-40X: combining Japan 🇯🇵 craftsmanship with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports and One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

description: The Arai EX-40X is tuned for city streets, daily work runs, and weekend joyrides, pairing agile street ergonomics with certified multi-impact protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing a featherweight 1284g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~88 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.
yoast_title: Arai EX-40X: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
introduction: Positioned in Arai's Full Face lineup, the EX-40X brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Arai EX-40X represents Arai's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~88 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Arai EX-40X delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
